capabilities: Create infinite canvas boards with nested sub-boards
Add note, image, link, file, to-do, column and comment cards
Draw freehand and connect cards with routed arrows
Record audio and transcribe it through the Whisper API
Export boards to Markdown or JSON Canvas and import them back
disambiguation: Not a kanban or task board; it is a freeform infinite canvas of cards.
extras: Formerly named Maguilanote; the plugin folder keeps the maguilanote id. Cloud collaboration is stated as out of scope, and boards sync only through whatever vault sync the user already uses.
problem: Notes are linear, so users who think visually have no place inside the vault to arrange notes, images, links and drawings spatially.
summary: Infinite-canvas board plugin that keeps each board as a local .board JSON file holding notes, images, links, drawings, to-do lists and arrows.
